name: Kuro
source:
She is a little bit bossy girl with cat ears. She takes good care of those whom she has allowed herself to get to know, and tries to act like a big sister.

On the other hand, she has many pet peeves and is sensitive to smells. She hides it in front of everyone, but in reality, she wants to be spoiled.

Her instincts react to anything that moves, and she chases after it as soon as she sees it. She feels good when she is stroked on the back of her neck and ears.

[From [url=https://watakubi.com/islanddiary/]official site[/url]]
